title: The Hollow Signal
author: P. M. Whitlock
blurb: Mara Okafor, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
